component.name: Ninja Launcher
component.summary: Open-source launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition

description.p: Ninja Launcher installs and launches Minecraft: Java Edition. Each instance lives in its own folder, and the launcher only talks to official services.

ul.li: Mods, modpacks, shaders and resource packs from Modrinth, with dependency and compatibility checks
Instance backups, repair and a crash-report viewer

description.p: You need a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.
